title: What Unitree's $650,000 transforming mech looks like from the inside
title_candidates: What Unitree's $650,000 transforming mech looks like from the inside
The civilian mech from Unitree that transforms with a person sitting inside
Unitree's manned mech can transform while you are riding in it
How a real 500 kg manned mech from Unitree actually moves
The first production mech built for civilians, and it transforms
caption:
Unitree built a manned mech that physically transforms, weighs 500 kg with a person inside, and starts at $650,000.

This is the GD01. It is the world's first production-ready civilian mecha. You sit inside it, it transforms around you, and you can actually order one. No military use. No concept art. It exists.

The company spent years making robot dogs and humanoid bots. This is a different kind of machine.
